newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - JUNE 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - JUNE 17.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the June 18 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Vladimir Zhirinovsky's Liberal Democratic Party (LDPR) suggests turning Vladimir Lenin's tomb into a money-spinning machine which will tour Russia, making money in the process.

- Russia, long barred by hostile international legislation from competing in the world space launch market, on Wednesday is likely to make its entry to devastating effect with the launch of seven satellites for U.S. telecommunications giant Motorola.

- Russia's biggest commercial bank, national savings bank Sberbank, which promised to keep its interest rates stable may be forced to cut them in the wake of the Central Bank's decision to significantly lower its refinancing rate.
- The crime rate in Russia is high but stable, says Justice Minister Valentin Kovalyov in an interview.
- Georgia has no intention of evicting Russia from the Caucasus, say Georgian President Eduard Shevardnadze in an interview.
- The designers of Russia's top fighter jet Sukhoi Su-37 are working overtime to get all the necessary documents for the plane to be shown at the Le Bourget air show in Paris.
